description: The supplied image contains no scientific figure. It is a publisher/Crossref "Check for updates" badge: a segmented circular ring drawn in yellow and blue arcs, enclosing a solid red ribbon or bookmark-shaped emblem with a notched lower edge, rendered on a pale grey gradient background. Beneath the ring the words "Check for updates" are printed in two lines of dark grey sans-serif type. There are no axes or axis units, no scale bars, no legends, no sample or condition labels, no data curves, no micrographs, no diffraction or spectroscopy patterns and no tabular cells of any kind; nothing in the image refers to low-density steel, multiphase heterogeneous microstructure, yield strength or elongation. The badge is a standard CrossRef update-check icon appended to a PDF, and its presence carries no materials-science information and cannot be linked to any panel discussed in the paper. It is assigned to chart_schematic only because the taxonomy contains no logo/icon category; the group is not a composite figure. The image is complete but slightly soft at the supplied resolution; the badge wording remains legible.

The text "Check for updates" is printed in two lines of dark grey sans-serif type directly below the ring.
The image contains no axes, tick labels, units, scale bars or colour-bar scales, so no quantity can be read from it.
No sample label, alloy designation, composition or processing condition is printed anywhere in the image.
No curves, micrographs, diffraction patterns, spectra, maps, tables or schematics of experimental steps are present.

The graphic is a standard CrossRef 'Check for updates' publisher badge, i.e. publication metadata artwork rather than a data figure, so it supplies no evidence about the paper's material or its mechanical properties.
